description: Unlock an achievement of a game for a player. Idempotent: unlocking it again returns already:true. Same proof, trust, session and author rules as submit_score; each achievement has its own min_trust (default client). Returns the achievement, its points and unlocked_at. AUTH — SIGN as the player (its key or owner session token also authorize, as client), or SIGN as a referee of the game.

id.description: the achievement id from the manifest

name.description: the app name or its slug

session_id.description: the play session it was earned in; default the player's latest session of this game

name: unlock_achievement
title: Unlock achievement
